text:
Alex Chen: noticed a regression in tail latency on kv-cache workloads after yesterday's kernel selector tweak. nvtx traces look odd.
Priya Nair: can you paste the nsys timeline?
Alex Chen: pasted snapshot (trimmed):
```
# time  ms  kernel             stream  notes
0.0    1   memcpyHtoD_async    s2     large pinned memcpy before kernels
1.2    0.2 cudaMalloc          sMain  huge spikes between batches
1.45   12  aten_kernel         s1     long running (fallback attn)
13.6   0.1 memcpyHtoD_async    s2     extra memcpy stall
```

Samir Rao: the cudaMalloc spikes are a red flag — our pool isn't capturing these allocations. Are these coming from the kv-cache evict path?
Alex Chen: yes looks like when we compact KV entries we free and reallocate pinned buffers for transfer; on certain traces cudaMalloc happens on hot path.
perf-bot: FYI this pattern shows up on the regression run for commit 9f3a2b (kernel-selector change).
Priya Nair: kernel selector changed threshold for fused->fallback at seq_len 1024, maybe more small-ish batches now pick fallback which allocs temp buffers differently.
Maria Gomez: I ran a quick nvprof on a repro and saw page-locked allocation (cudaHostAlloc) called from memcpy glue layer around every batch boundary. The allocator falls back to cudaMallocHost when pool is empty.
Samir Rao: two actionables: 1) enable cudaMallocAsync / cudaMemPool on CI machines (if driver+cuda support), 2) make our host-pinned pooling sticky for the KV path to avoid free/alloc churn.
Alex Chen: test patch attached (local) — switches hostalloc to use pre-allocated ring buffer per-device. micro-run shows 40-60% tail latency improvement.
Priya Nair: nice. Did you add NVTX ranges around host allocs? I want to verify they disappear from timeline.
Alex Chen: yep added NVTX_PUSH("host-pool-get") / POP around pool get; new nsys shows no cudaHostAlloc calls in steady state.
perf-bot: regression tag cleared if tail <= baseline+5%. Current run: tail improved 56%, p95 back to baseline.
Samir Rao: long-term: consider switching KV cache compaction to reuse pinned buffers in-place instead of free/alloc. Also add a safety cap that falls back to synchronous memcpy if pool depleted (avoid creating host alloc spike).
Maria Gomez: note for release notes: kernel-selector tweak caused indirect perf regression due to allocator interactions — might be worth adding a test in perf CI that synthetic workloads exercise the free/alloc churn.
Priya Nair: agreed. I'll add a small perf CI job: repeated small batches that force compaction every N requests.
Alex Chen: logging follow-up: added a short metric "hostalloc.calls_per_minute" and a debug flag to dump first 10 allocation callers. If we see >10/min on steady workloads that should alert.
Samir Rao: small UX ask: infra team to verify memory pool settings on Dedicated instances — some older AMIs don't have cudaMallocAsync support and we need fallback paths.
infra-bot: noted. Opening infra ticket INFRA-4721 to run driver checks and enable mempool where supported.
Maria Gomez: thanks everyone — i'll close out once CI job lands and infra ticket is created. :thumbsup:
